name: Todd Bureau
abstract_title: From Evidence to Understanding: Consciousness Beyond the Brain and the Educational Imperative
abstract: Across multiple lines of inquiry, evidence has accumulated suggesting that consciousness cannot be reduced to the activity of the brain alone. Rigorous studies of near-death and out-of-body experiences, veridical perceptions during clinical death, telepathic exchanges, and correlations between collective emotional states and the behaviour of random number generators all challenge the materialist assumption that consciousness is confined to the head.
